title: Signing Identity Card v1
description: CHIT signing identity card: binds a machine-readable key/material proof (ml) with a human-readable agent identity (h) so that every signed trail entry can be audited back to a specific card.

card_id.description: Stable UUID for this signing card. Recorded in signature.v1 payloads as signing_card_id.

ml.description: Machine-learnt / machine-readable proof of signing authority.

primary_method.description: The canonical attestation method used with this card.

ssh_fingerprint.description: OpenSSH public-key fingerprint when primary_method is ssh.

ssh_allowed_signers_line.description: allowed_signers file entry used by ssh-keygen -Y verify.

gpg_key_id.description: Long-form GPG key ID or fingerprint when primary_method is gpg.

github_app_installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID when primary_method is github-app.

ci_runner_label.description: Optional self-hosted runner label that may only sign when running on a matching runner.

h.description: Human-readable identity metadata displayed in audit UIs and trail visualizations.

glyph.description: One- or two-character glyph used in compact UI badges.

color.description: Hex color for UI rendering of this agent's identity.

voice.description: Optional voice/persona identifier for spoken audit playback.

role.description: Classification of the identity's operating role.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the card was first issued.

rotated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last rotation/re-key, if any.

active.description: Whether this card may currently be used to sign CHIT trail entries.

supersedes_card_id.description: If this card replaces an older card, the superseded card_id.

notes.description: Free-form audit notes (e.g., node assignment, rotation reason).
